name: io.github.jupnet/gum-cli
title: GUM Trading CLI & MCP
description: Trade spot tokens, tokenized stocks, and up to 50x perps across chains on GUM by Jupiter.

environmentVariables.name: GUM_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional base58 or JSON-array Solana private key for headless signing (otherwise uses ~/.config/gum profile).

environmentVariables.name: GUM_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM private key for headless signing (otherwise uses ~/.config/gum profile).

environmentVariables.name: GUM_MAX_TRADE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-trade or withdrawal USD limit enforced locally before signing.

environmentVariables.name: GUM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Trading API base URL override (defaults to https://api.gum.ag/app/v1).
